name: Event RSVP
description: Collect guest responses, track attendance status, and prepare calendar/sheet exports.
instructions: For the Event RSVP template, support reusable event-specific RSVP links. Store events and responses app-scoped. Respondent links use ?event=<slug-or-id>; respondent identity comes from the logged-in Hangar user, with optional &email=<email> retained only as a legacy fallback. Do not ask respondents to type their email. Use Google Sheets for attendee exports and Google Mail for invitation workflows.
